```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(officedown)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.cap.style = "Image Caption", fig.cap.pre = "Figure ", fig.cap.sep = ": ", fig.lp = "fig:", fig.topcaption = FALSE, fig.align = "center", fig.style = "Normal")
knitr::knit_hooks$set(plot = officedown:::plot_word_fig_caption)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-a
#| fig-cap: "CAP-A"
plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-b
#| fig-cap: "CAP-B"
plot(3:1)
```

See @fig-a and @fig-b.
